time_convention: t = frame / 24; frame = round(t * 24); frame 0 at t = 0
pixel_convention: x to the right, y downward, full-resolution pixels (2560x1440)
view: top-down (camera looking straight down at a white floor/backdrop); the aircraft flies parallel to the floor, its shadow falls on the floor

camera.motion: static (no pan/shake: background corners unchanged within <0.5 grey levels except when aircraft/shadow pass)
camera.picture_area: letterboxed: picture rows y = 80..1359 (1280 rows), black bars above and below
camera.perspective: none usable; single planar motion facing the camera; apparent size of the aircraft constant (wingspan 725 px in every frame 0..64 by raw silhouette)

objects.name: aircraft
objects.description: the only moving object: grey/silver fighter-like aircraft seen from above, nose pointing LEFT (-x), swept wings with two rotor fans and two long under-wing pods, twin tail fins at the right end. Appears dark/black near the right and left edges of the picture (lighting falloff), light grey in the middle.
objects.visible_frames: 0-71 (fully in picture 0-56; nose/pod tips leave the left edge from frame 57; frame 71 only the tail end, ~90 px)
objects.reference_point: ref_x, ref_y = centre of the aircraft's 2D bounding box (pod tips to tail tip, wingtip to wingtip). Use as origin proxy. centroid_x/y (silhouette area centroid, ~38 px forward/left of the box centre) also given; the two differ by a constant, so displacements/speeds are identical.

size_px.length_note: x extent from the under-wing pod tips/forward guns (x=1133 at frame 24) to the fuselage tail tip (x=1698 at frame 24); fuselage centre line itself spans ~1202..1698
size_px.wingspan_note: y = 367..1091 wingtip fairing to wingtip fairing, constant all frames

objects.motion_summary_px: frames 0 and 1 identical (stationary); from frame 1->2 onward it moves left in a straight horizontal line (y constant to +-0.03 px) by 34.1-34.5 px per frame (template frames 2-60), no visible acceleration; exits the left edge (fully gone after frame 71).

objects.name: aircraft_shadow
objects.description: soft, blurred dark shadow of the aircraft on the floor; moves with the aircraft but its offset from the aircraft changes (lies to the right of the aircraft at the start, under/behind it mid-clip, to the left of it near the end) - a point/near light source above the centre. NOT part of the aircraft; excluded from all aircraft measurements.

objects.name: floor_backdrop
objects.description: uniform white/light-grey floor filling the picture, darker towards the right edge (vignette). No markings.

objects.name: backdrop_edge
objects.description: static dark curved boundary at the right edge of the picture (edge of the floor plane / backdrop): starts at x~2390 near the top row of the picture (y~90), x~2516 at mid-height (y~720), x~2454 near the bottom (y~1350); beyond it is black.

events.event: motion start (first displacement between frame 1 and 2)
aircraft first touches left picture edge (pod tips at x~0)
box centre (ref point) crosses left edge x=0
last frame, only tail tip (~80 px) visible

no_events: no bounces, contacts, impacts or direction changes; straight-line leftward motion throughout
